notes: A reply written on a Discord ticket, including an attached image, is posted in the Discord channel and its responses thread.
Images sent in a Discord ticket are saved on the site, so they keep showing after the Discord link expires.
Close Ticket in Discord closes the website ticket, or says why it could not.
After a restart the linking bot starts map votes and updates immediately. The full role sync keeps running in the background instead of blocking that loop for about an hour.
Saving the same Discord app as LINK_BOT_TOKEN or SUPPORT_BOT_TOKEN is refused. That second login crashes ticket buttons.
added: Website ticket replies are relayed to the matching Discord ticket channel.
Discord ticket images are copied into site storage.
changed: The linking bot only receives admin logs and map votes newer than its last check.
Close Ticket can find the website ticket from the Discord channel when the bot no longer has the ticket id.
